output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-a1761ecdb17b] is one entry in the "These metrics will be changed" list. The section's lead paragraph [ev-1f419676f177] says what happens to every metric in that list: in 3.0.0 the `cortex_` prefix becomes `loki_`. So this metric becomes `loki_prometheus_rule_group_interval_seconds`. Exposure depends on `metrics_namespace` being left at its new default of `loki`, because setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name; that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. That is enough to write the subject (the metric name), the change (a rename with a stated replacement), the applicability (the `metrics_namespace` value) and the consequence (anything that queries the old `cortex_` name stops finding it). The proposals all missed this because they looked only at the bare bullet.
